notes.title: Art Contest + Language update is available now
notes.notes:
Hey,

[b]Mr. Franklin[/b] took over our stream last night, but we have [b]good news![/b] 🤡
[list]
    [*]From [b]11th[/b] to [b]20th[/b] of [b]February 2021[/b], you'll have a chance to win a [b]free copy of the game[/b].ːdba_motherː
    [*]Just send us your [b]fan arts[/b] of "Don't Be Afraid" to [b][i]kontakt@hydragames.pl[/i][/b]. ːdba_backpackː

notes.title: Don't Be Afraid Release Date
notes.notes:
Hello Guys,

[b]The game's new release date is on the 26th of November.[/b] 
This is our last delay, bare with us as we are working on the game as hard as we can so it could [b]reach beyond your expectations.[/b]
We can't tell you anything else than it is packed full of surprises and jump scares. [b]Stay tuned![/b]

Be sure to check out the date reveal trailer [b][url=https://youtu.be/p0zezyBQHiw]HERE[/url][/b]

[i]Broken Arrow Games and Hydra Games[/i]

notes.title: New full release date reveal!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
[h3]We are coming to you with some big news!
The great premiere of [b] "Don't Be Afraid"[/b] will take place on [b]22nd of October, 2020![/b][/h3]

[h3]We saw a great opportunity to expand our game with even [b]more content[/b] and also to further enhance its overall experience.[/h3]

[b]"Don't Be Afraid"[/b] is a very important title for us and we want it to be as unique, horrific experience, as possible.
Thank you for all your support and we hope that playing "Don't Be Afraid" will be a remarkable experience for you![/h3]

Be sure to check out the date reveal trailer [h2][b][url=https://youtu.be/ci2Kgw4arfQ]HERE![/url][/b][/h2]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31496194/013c6877c70714984c77316e616a7b778671d772.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31496194/013c6877c70714984c77316e616a7b778671d772.gif[/img][/url]

Also definitely try [b]"Don't Be Afraid: The First Toy"[/b], a free prologue. The game is a great starter for the upcoming experience of David's scary adventures in "Don't Be Afraid". Here's the link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1311250/

And don't forget to add [b]“Don’t Be Afraid”[/b] to your Steam Wishlist!

[i]Broken Arrow Games and Hydra Games[/i]
